purpose: commercial title, loading handoff and first-play visual slice

style_contract.tone: approachable and game-like without becoming childish, comic slapstick, or generic corporate illustration
style_contract.consistency: portrait and map art must depict the same person with the same face, age, PPE, outfit language, and signature prop
style_contract.readability: character identity must survive small in-game scale through silhouette plus at least two of face, outfit, prop, and posture
style_contract.world_rule: construction details, access routes, temporary works, materials, equipment, and safety cues must feel plausible rather than decorative

shared_reject_conditions: real or invented company, project, apartment, site, or building names rendered as readable text inside the artwork
pseudo text or meaningless lettering on helmets, PPE, signs, or equipment
baked-in HUD, title logo, dialogue box, mission panel, resource counter, map label, or navigation UI inside a production art slot
multi-asset contact sheet, mockup board, screenshot collage, or composite presentation submitted as a single production asset
extra fingers, duplicated limbs, broken PPE geometry, or fused tools
portrait and map variants that no longer read as the same person
slapstick treatment of hazards or incidents
portrait or map art that reuses another title-cast face geometry despite different PPE, hair, or outfit

assets.production_brief: Landscape 16:9 construction foundation-stage strategy map. Apartment structure, tower crane, material yard, temporary access road, gate, rebar/formwork zones and worker circulation should create a readable playable diorama with foreground/midground/background depth. Keep the central worksite clear enough for interactive markers and characters. Artwork only: no baked-in HUD, title, dialogue, mission cards, resource counters, map labels, readable company/project/site/building names, logos, or signage text.

Young Korean female safety manager, late 20s. Distinct soft V-shaped face, narrow soft jaw, focused almond eyes, fine straight brows, small straight nose, dark low ponytail and side fringe visible below a white helmet with a simple blue stripe and no text. Navy field jacket and blue safety vest. Calm, alert and approachable. Upper-body portrait with black inspection tablet. Must not resemble Lim Junho or Lee Jaehoon.

Same player identity as the portrait in a full-body 3/4 strategy-map pose. Compact athletic build, clearly feminine face and body read, white-blue helmet, navy/blue safety clothing and black inspection tablet must remain legible at small scale. No chibi proportions; must not reuse the male title-cast face template.

White helmet, clean blue site jacket, rolled construction drawing. Upright professional stance, slightly pressed for time. Upper-body portrait. Must not resemble the player, Lim Junho, or Seo Jeongmin.

Same Lee Jaehoon identity as the portrait in a full-body 3/4 strategy-map pose. Tall slim vertical silhouette, white helmet, clean blue site jacket and rolled drawing under one arm. Long narrow face remains readable; no glasses and no youthful round-face template.

Thin oblong mature face, narrow angular jaw, prominent cheekbones, narrow observant eyes, thin straight brows, long sharp nose, black hair with grey temples and rectangular glasses. Plain white inspector helmet, dark inspection jacket, clipboard close to chest. Reserved analytical expression. Must not resemble Lee Jaehoon.

Same Seo Jeongmin identity as the portrait in a full-body 3/4 strategy-map pose. Lean formal mature silhouette, rectangular glasses, white inspector helmet, dark jacket and clipboard close to chest.
